stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Big Finish

stories.detail: 5 1-pointers - found a formula and sticking to it

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 8 & 9 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: High Low Express
stories.detail: From 4-pointer to wipe in one hole - nobody does it like this

stories.detail: 3 wipes to open on holes 1, 2 & 3 - the real round starts now

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 5 & 6 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 9 holes - technically a very consistent performance
